summary: Five pear-shaped lab-grown diamonds, approximately 0.30 ct each, arranged into a delicate flower in 14K solid gold.
description:
A delicate floral-inspired design featuring five brilliant pear-shaped lab-grown diamonds arranged into a flower. Elegant, feminine and timeless.

Available in 14K solid white, yellow or rose gold, with approximately 1.50 ct total diamond weight.

All diamond weights and measurements are approximate and may vary slightly. Each piece may have minor variations in stone appearance and setting. Product colours may differ slightly due to lighting and screen settings. **Additional rings shown in photos are for styling purposes only and are not included.**
care: Store separately in a soft pouch. Clean gently with a soft jewellery cloth and avoid harsh chemicals.
